new.title: Learning to Probe Footholds for Humanoid Ladder Climbing
new.desc: This thesis will use learning from demonstration and reinforcement learning to develop a humanoid ladder-climbing policy that probes for support during ascent and descent when the next rung or the ground is out of view.
